description: Check the one-time code the user received from start_phone_verification. On success the balance is unlocked for funding (the verification stays fresh for 60 days) — call add_funds next. A wrong or expired code returns a recoverable status so you can ask the user to re-check it, or call start_phone_verification to resend.

code.description: The one-time code the user received, as a string (keep any leading zeros — do not send it as a number).

name: verify_phone
